Method of Attack: Malicious PowerShell scripts delivered via steganography in images hosted on public image hosting services (Imgur, Imgbox)
Phishing emails with Microsoft Office documents containing malicious macros that decrypt and execute PowerShell scripts
Payload encoded with Base64, encrypted with RSA, and hidden in images
Payload executes Mimikatz open-source application to extract Windows credentials
Impacted Systems: Windows systems matching the locale of the phishing email
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with malicious Microsoft Office documents containing macros
Indicators of Compromise: Images downloaded from Imgur and Imgbox hosting services containing encrypted payloads
PowerShell scripts running with parameters: -WindowStyle Hidden, -ExecutionPolicy Bypass, -NoProfile
Exception messages used as decryption keys dependent on system language
